findings.text: follow-on: the module docstring and the plan_fingerprint docstring still state that authored comments and followups are digested except the landing comments a promotion writes, while _without_comments_and_followups drops both keys entirely; the gained commit codifies the section-21 rule in the test but the module's own statement of the rule is still the old one, so a reader of plan_review.py is told the opposite of what plan_fingerprint does.

item_verdicts.diff: read against 63bb3c22; the commit removes the sweep case and its _sweep/_quiet helpers and the os/time/recovery imports, retitles the fingerprint case, adds an _edit_a_decision helper, and asserts an authored comment leaves the digest unchanged.
item_verdicts.done_when: this commit's own subject is the resume finding that the fingerprint case asserted the retired behaviour, and the rewritten case drives plan_fingerprint over a synthesised mounted project and passes at head while failing at base.
item_verdicts.goal: the gained commit is the resume's test-only fix: it rewrites tests/test_a_run_comment_earns_no_plan_review.py to the rule section 21 established, that comments and followups left the fingerprint's document unit, and deletes the sweep case that drove the plan walk the section's earlier node retired; the fingerprint case now holds a run comment and an authored comment each leaving the digest unchanged while a decision-text edit moves it.
item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed manifest reads status complete, commits e2716ca4, 63bb3c22 and f5eef14c7, and now carries baseline_suite (64e6b3376, 2 failed, EXIT=1) and after_suite (f5eef14c7, 0 failed, EXIT=0) with their log paths.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the commit touches one path, tests/test_a_run_comment_earns_no_plan_review.py, which lies outside the run's originally declared six write paths; the run's manifest records that the resume granted the write in writing and the coordinator pre-accepted it at promotion.

justifications.durability: the rewritten case drives the real machinery - promotion._record_landing_comment, the plan store and plan_fingerprint over the on-disk plan - and asserts the digest before and after each write rather than a value it fed in, so it fails when the exclusion is reverted.
justifications.evidence: the head arm passes (independently reproduced: 1 passed EXIT=0) and the base arm fails the same file (2 failed EXIT=1, reproduced from a scratch extraction of 63bb3c22); deducted one because the run's declared negative control targets tests/test_nothing_sweeps_old_plans.py, so the mutation reddening this file's own assertions is the base arm alone.
justifications.fit: the file keeps its fixture and helpers, the new _edit_a_decision writes a decision the way the plan surface does through _plan_html.read_state/write_state, and the module docstring is updated to the new rule; deducted one because the test names sections, decisions and dependencies while the implementation digests relationships.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the commit does exactly the resume's acts on the one file it names - the stale assertion that an authored comment moves the fingerprint is corrected to the implemented rule and the test driving the deleted walk is removed - with the plan walk already gone at base.
justifications.reuse: the change deletes a redundant test and a helper rather than adding a mechanism, and introduces no definition that re-implements one the repository already owns.
justifications.scope_discipline: the commit's single path lies outside the run's originally declared write paths; the deviation is granted in writing in the resume and pre-accepted at promotion and is recorded in the run's scope_grant line, but check-manifest still reports it.
